checks: Canonical existing Work and persisted activity loaded through real Main/preload/bridge.
No Node/credential/generic IPC API; arbitrary local-file fetch, navigation, popups, notifications and forged profile rejected.
Native 1280/736/360px resize and 200% zoom retain a reachable composer without horizontal overflow.
Synthetic credential stages over real fd3, input clears, reload closes its authority, ordinary renderer receives no credential or staging API.
Terminating the owned bridge reconnects automatically to the same supervisor.
Profile switch, quit/relaunch, reconnect and supervisor restart preserve canonical ownership; no dispatch or global pointer mutation.
Incompatible existing host stays inspectable and cannot be replaced or dispatched by Desktop.
